mapper.select: SELECT r.group_id FROM rounds r INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id WHERE g.group_status = 'ONGOING' AND r.round_status = 'ONGOING' AND r.end_date = #{endDate} ORDER BY r.group_id
SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE round_status = 'ONGOING' AND end_date = #{endDate} ORDER BY group_id, round_no
SELECT group_id, moim_account_id, user_id, round_cycle_days, default_fail_pass_count, future_deposit_ratio_rule, base_deposit_amount, group_status FROM `groups` WHERE group_id = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT round_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status FROM rounds WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY round_no DESC

SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND round_status = 'ONGOING' AND end_date = #{endDate} ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rounds ( group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{roundNo}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{roundStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `groups` SET group_status = 'ONGOING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND group_status = 'RECRUITING'
mapper.select: SELECT gu.user_id, ( SELECT a.account_id FROM accounts a WHERE a.user_id = gu.user_id AND a.account_status IN ('INCOME', 'INOUTCOME') ORDER BY CASE a.account_status WHEN 'INCOME' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS account_id FROM group_users gu WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND gu.group_user_status IN ('PENDING_DEPOSIT', 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY gu.group_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO round_history ( round_id, user_id, account_id, moim_account_id, success_count, remaining_fail_pass_count ) VALUES ( #{roundId}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{moimAccountId}, #{successCount}, #{remainingFailPassCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE round_id = #{roundId}

SELECT rh.round_history_id AS roundUserId, rh.user_id, u.nickname, rh.success_count FROM round_history rh INNER JOIN users u ON rh.user_id = u.user_id WHERE rh.round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY rh.success_count DESC, rh.round_history_id ASC

SELECT rh.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY rh.success_count DESC ) AS rankNo, rh.success_count AS successCount FROM round_history rh INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = rh.user_id WHERE rh.round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY rankNo ASC, rh.round_history_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE round_history rh INNER JOIN ( SELECT ranked.round_history_id, ranked.calculated_rank FROM ( SELECT rh2.round_history_id, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY rh2.success_count DESC ) AS calculated_rank FROM round_history rh2 WHERE rh2.round_id = #{roundId} ) ranked ) result ON result.round_history_id = rh.round_history_id SET rh.rank_no = result.calculated_rank WHERE rh.round_id = #{roundId}
mapper.select: SELECT rh.round_history_id AS settlementId, rh.user_id AS userId, rh.settlement_amount AS settlementAmount, rh.settlement_at AS createdAt, kb.bank_name AS bankName, CASE WHEN kb.account_number IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(kb.account_number) <= 8 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT( LEFT(kb.account_number, 4), REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(kb.account_number) - 8), RIGHT(kb.account_number, 4) ) END AS maskedAccountNumber FROM round_history rh LEFT JOIN kb_transfer_requests ktr ON ktr.round_id = rh.round_id AND ktr.settlement_receiver_id = rh.user_id AND ktr.transaction_category = 'SETTLEMENT' AND ktr.transfer_status = 'SUCCESS' LEFT JOIN kb_accounts kb ON kb.kb_account_id = ktr.destination_kb_account_id WHERE rh.round_id = #{roundId} AND rh.settlement_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rh.rank_no ASC, rh.user_id ASC
